title: MA61047: Nonlinear Functional Analysis
text:
Syllabus
Syllabus mentioned in ERP

Prerequisite: Functional AnalysisFixed point theory, Banach contraction
mapping theorem, contractive type mappings, generalizations of Banach
contraction mapping theorem, fixed point theorem of other types. Nonlinear
operators, monotone, srictly monotone and strongly monotone operators, their
properties and applications. Variational inequalities and complementarity
problem. Approximation theory, theory of best approximation and farthest
points, calculus of Banach space, Frechet and Gateaux differntialability,
strict convexity and uniform convexity of norms, semi inner product spaces.
